hints.title: BST Ordering Property
hints.text: If a node value is strictly less than low, then every node in its left subtree is also less than low and cannot be part of the result.

hints.title: Prune Out-of-Bounds Subtrees
hints.text: Similarly, if a node value exceeds high, its entire right subtree is also strictly greater than high and can be discarded.

hints.title: Recursive Re-attachment
hints.text: If node value is below low, return trim on the right child. If node value exceeds high, return trim on the left child. Otherwise, trim both children and return the node.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Recursive BST filtering pruning branches falling outside [low, high].
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing both branches unconditionally fails to exploit BST ordered properties.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pruning entire out-of-range subtrees reduces work and limits recursion stack to O(H).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use the BST property: if root.val < low, discard root and left child, return trimmed right child, and vice versa.
